topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 59 project-authored contract(s) across 6 chain(s); 3 ERC4626 vaults, 9 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 13 common project-authored base contract(s) (decentralizedindex, oftcore, oapp). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
